round2_corrections: 2026-05-08: dropped KAISER (No.173, dup of ARIF); reclassified Nos. 171, 172, 177 (U-235) and 179 (U-233) from SCA to SCR per Capote/Pronyaev review
2026-05-08: Westcott factors updated to B81-derived values (Capote round 2)
round3_corrections: 2026-06-23: fission + (n,tot) data revision (Capote/Duran). Built from step-5 favoured base. 15 transmission updates, 2 fission updates, 10 deletions, 26 additions (Nos. 195-220), U-234(n,g)->100.9 b. SCA/SCR classification of existing entries unchanged. See references/emails/tnc_update_roberto_20260623/data_change_manifest.md
metadata.sensitivity_variant: Round 3 with Pu-239 transmission Nos. 75 (Pattenden) and 192 (Anderson) reclassified (ABS 39)+SCR 39 -> (ABS 39)+SCA 39, per Gilles's query on the SCR assignment of the two high values.
